title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: In South Sudan, ICSP strengthened community and county‑level health and nutrition systems through clinical mentoring, joint supervision and closer coordination with County Health Departments across Abyei, Kajo‑Keji, Renk, Twic and Ulang. Community vulnerability decreased through screening of 26,269 children and referral of 852 SAM cases, alongside Mother‑to‑Mother Support Groups promoting improved feeding and hygiene, contributing to 71% adoption of recommended health and WASH practices. Preparedness advanced through updated emergency plans, trained Rapid Response Teams and coordinated cholera, polio and AWD responses, supporting a health resilience score of 60%, exceeding programme targets.. Social Behaviour Change (SBC) approaches are used to build community and household capacity to care for their own health – including Care Groups, Men’s Health Groups, and community based reproductive health volunteers who work to increase the demand for health services.
